initial_review.adjudication: The blind reconstruction recovered the 19 September advance announcement retaining foreigner restrictions. The current record already distinguishes that announcement from Cristian Diaz's 21 September field report at Las Chinamas. The later article records 34 foreign admissions and interviews a Guatemalan traveller, with PCR conditions and citizen/diplomat exemptions. Retain the 21 September endpoint for the stated foreign-entry scope at the observed crossing; do not generalize to all posts or unrestricted entry.
